landing.community: Join the biggest community of party people
landing.wait: Don't wait for the perfect opportunity, hop-out!

us.paragraph1: Tired of spending endless hours searching for interesting and fun activities around you ? You came to the right address! Our mission is to make you hop out of your house and join the events that you're looking for, find people with the same interests and make new connections
us.paragraph2: Enjoy the endless possibilities of finding new friends, exploring different cities and enjoying life all with a few clicks on your phone or computer. Don't wait for the perfect opportunity, create one yourself!
us.hopout1: HopAut is a geosocial mobile and web based application allowing user to easily create, attend and explore various types of events scattered around their city!
us.hopout2: Utilizing GPS tracking, HopAut can pinpoint the user's current location and display events in close vacinity, mitigating the need to search for hours on end for fun activities!
us.card1-text: No more tedious registration processes and endless forms. Register within a minute and Hop Out!
us.card2-text: Whatever you are looking for, whether it's a party or car, bicycle or bike meet, it's all here, don't miss it!
us.card3-text: Are you a party animal? Find your people and make some good memories. Within 2 minutes you can post your party for free and let the others know.
